quote: I made a promise to a dying woman. Everything since has just been keeping it.
Retirement is just another word for waiting to be found.
An empire built on secrets eventually becomes a prison made of them.
Every man I've betrayed is a debt. I intend to die owing as few as possible.
A congressman with a subpoena is still just a man with a piece of paper.
I've spent my life staying one step ahead of the people who want me dead. Old habits don't retire either.
Family isn't the people who share your blood. It's the people who show up when the bull is charging.
I never asked to be remembered fondly. Just remembered accurately.
The last chapter doesn't erase the ones before it. It just explains them.
There's a difference between running from your past and finally outrunning it.
In the end, all any of us leave behind is who we chose to protect.
